planned_atomic_boundary: Exact-read canonical LIVE state; bind predecessor LATEST blob + canonical LIVE blob + semantic-envelope version + expected digest; run one deterministic in-memory self-consistent max_attempts substitution control and untouched control; reject substituted authority and admit untouched authority; do not mutate LIVE state.

switch_threshold: On canonical LIVE blob mismatch, authority tuple mismatch, unavailable write/readback, or any CAS drift: stop this leaf without retry/wait and preserve an exact recurring-open continuation naming the mismatch.
